text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: To my beloved Mom and Dad, Today's the day of my big race. And it's the day of Mifuyu's big test too.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: The two of us are inching closer and closer to our dreams. And I can't forget that I've got someone else who said she'd be waiting for me to run today.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: I wanna live up to City's expectations. In fact, the two of us agreed to make today's race the best ever—one where we can love who we've become when we cross the finish line!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: We're gonna make this our race and carve our dreams into this track for everyone to see. And that's a promise!
